reductionRule: Repeatedly sum the individual digits of a number until a single digit (1-9) remains, with ONE exception: never reduce the master numbers 11, 22, or 33. Concretely: (1) if the number is 11, 22, or 33, stop and keep it as-is; (2) otherwise, if the number is greater than 9, replace it with the sum of its digits and repeat from step 1; (3) otherwise (1-9) stop. Master numbers are preserved when they appear as a final total and, per common practice, when an intermediate component total equals 11, 22, or 33 before a final reduction. IMPORTANT SCOPE NOTE FOR CYCLES: the forecasting cycles below follow the most-common convention where Personal Year / Month / Day are ALWAYS reduced to a single digit 1-9 (masters NOT preserved), Pinnacles DO preserve master numbers, and Challenges are reduced to plain single digits with NO master preservation and can equal 0.

personalYear.method: reduce(reducedBirthMonth + reducedBirthDay + reducedCurrentYear). Reduce the birth month, the birth day, and the CURRENT (forecast) calendar year each to a single digit first, add them, then reduce the sum. Birth month = calendar number reduced (Jan=1 ... Sep=9, Oct=10->1, Nov=11->2, Dec=12->3). Birth day = day-of-month reduced (e.g. 15->6, 29->2+9=11->2). Current year = sum of its four digits reduced (2026 -> 2+0+2+6 = 10 -> 1+0 = 1).
personalYear.masterConvention: COMMON CONVENTION (used here): the Personal Year is ALWAYS reduced to a single digit 1-9; master numbers are NOT preserved at any step of the Personal Year (nor its Month/Day descendants). This is the mainstream convention for annual forecasting because the personal-year runs a repeating 1-9 cycle. A minority of numerologists preserve 11/22/33 in the Personal Year; if a product wants that variant it should be an explicit opt-in flag, but the default and the test cases here reduce fully to 1-9.
personalYear.worked: For birth May 15, forecast year 2026: birth month = 5; birth day = 15 -> 1+5 = 6; year 2026 -> 2+0+2+6 = 10 -> 1+0 = 1. Sum = 5 + 6 + 1 = 12 -> 1+2 = 3. Personal Year = 3.

personalMonth.method: reduce(personalYear + reducedCalendarMonth). Take the Personal Year number (already reduced to 1-9) for the year that the target calendar month falls in, add the reduced calendar-month number (Jan=1 ... Dec=12->3), and reduce the sum to a single digit 1-9. Master numbers are NOT preserved (same convention as Personal Year).
personalMonth.masterConvention: Always reduced to a single digit 1-9; masters not preserved.
personalMonth.worked: For birth May 15 in June 2026: Personal Year 2026 = 3 (see personalYear). Calendar month June = 6. Sum = 3 + 6 = 9 -> already single digit. Personal Month = 9. (A reducing example, October: month Oct = 10 -> 1; 3 + 1 = 4, Personal Month = 4.)

personalDay.method: reduce(personalMonth + reducedCalendarDay). Take the Personal Month number (reduced 1-9) for the month the target date falls in, add the reduced calendar day-of-month (e.g. the 21st -> 2+1 = 3), and reduce the sum to a single digit 1-9. Equivalent one-shot form: reduce(personalYear + reducedCalendarMonth + reducedCalendarDay). Master numbers are NOT preserved.
personalDay.masterConvention: Always reduced to a single digit 1-9; masters not preserved.
personalDay.worked: For birth May 15 on June 21 2026: Personal Month (June 2026) = 9 (see personalMonth). Calendar day 21 -> 2+1 = 3. Sum = 9 + 3 = 12 -> 1+2 = 3. Personal Day = 3.

pinnacles.method: Four pinnacle cycles derived from the birth date's month, day, and year, each first reduced to a single digit or master number (call them M, D, Y). P1 (First Pinnacle) = reduce(M + D). P2 (Second Pinnacle) = reduce(D + Y). P3 (Third Pinnacle) = reduce(P1 + P2). P4 (Fourth Pinnacle) = reduce(M + Y). Pinnacles DO preserve master numbers 11, 22, 33 (both in the M/D/Y components and in the pinnacle totals), consistent with the Life Path treatment.
pinnacles.masterConvention: Master numbers 11/22/33 ARE preserved for pinnacles (unlike Personal Year/Month/Day and unlike Challenges).
pinnacles.timing: The pinnacle timing is anchored to the Life Path number reduced to a single digit 1-9 (if the Life Path is a master 11/22/33, reduce it: 11->2, 22->4, 33->6). Let L = that single-digit Life Path. The FIRST Pinnacle runs from birth (age 0) through the year the person turns (36 - L); that final age (36 - L) is the age at which P1 ends and P2 begins. Each of the Second and Third Pinnacles lasts exactly 9 years. The Fourth Pinnacle begins after the Third ends and continues for the rest of life. Precisely, with endAge1 = 36 - L: P1 = ages 0 to endAge1; P2 = ages (endAge1) to (endAge1 + 9); P3 = ages (endAge1 + 9) to (endAge1 + 18); P4 = ages (endAge1 + 18) onward. (The boundary ages are transition years shared by the adjacent pinnacles; presenting them as P1: 0..endAge1, P2: endAge1+1..endAge1+9, P3: endAge1+10..endAge1+18, P4: endAge1+19+ is the common inclusive-range display.)
pinnacles.worked: Birth July 4, 1990 (1990-07-04). Reduce components: M = 7; D = 4; Y = 1990 -> 1+9+9+0 = 19 -> 1+9 = 10 -> 1+0 = 1. P1 = reduce(7 + 4) = reduce(11) = 11 (master, kept). P2 = reduce(4 + 1) = 5. P3 = reduce(P1 + P2) = reduce(11 + 5) = reduce(16) = 1+6 = 7. P4 = reduce(7 + 1) = 8. So P1=11, P2=5, P3=7, P4=8. Life Path = reduce(7 + 4 + 1) = reduce(12) = 3, so L = 3 and endAge1 = 36 - 3 = 33: P1 ends at 33, P2 = 34-42, P3 = 43-51, P4 = 52+.

challenges.method: Four challenge numbers via ABSOLUTE DIFFERENCES of the birth date's month, day, and year AFTER each is reduced to a single digit (plain reduction, NO master preservation, so M, D, Y are each 1-9). C1 (First Challenge) = |M - D|. C2 (Second Challenge) = |D - Y|. C3 (Third/Main Challenge) = |C1 - C2|. C4 (Fourth Challenge) = |M - Y|. Because these are absolute differences of single digits 1-9, each challenge is in the range 0-8; a value of 0 is valid and meaningful, and 9 can never occur.
challenges.masterConvention: Challenges are NOT reduced to master numbers. Reduce M, D, Y to plain single digits (11->2, 22->4, 29->2, etc.) before differencing. The result 0 is possible (when the two values are equal); the max possible is 8.

Pinnacle timing for birth December 25, 1988. Life Path = reduce(3+7+8)=reduce(18)=9, so L=9; endAge1 = 36-9 = 27. Inclusive display ranges: P1 0-27, P2 28-36, P3 37-45, P4 46+.
